color_bad.description: Color for the offline state and for latencies above the yellow threshold.
color_bad.label: Red

color_good.description: Color for latencies below the green threshold.
color_good.label: Green

color_warn.description: Color for latencies between the green and the yellow threshold.
color_warn.label: Yellow

host.description: What to ping. An IP avoids depending on DNS.
host.label: Host

interval_seconds.description: How often the host is pinged.
interval_seconds.label: Check interval (s)

threshold_good.description: Below this round-trip time the value is green.
threshold_good.label: Green below (ms)

threshold_warn.description: Below this round-trip time the value is yellow, above it red.
threshold_warn.label: Yellow below (ms)

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for a reply before treating it as offline.
timeout_seconds.label: Timeout (s)

animate.description: Pulse the dot once per answered ping. Turn off for a steady dot.
animate.label: Animate

avg_count.description: Average the last n successful pings instead of showing only the latest. 1 shows the latest ping as-is.
avg_count.label: Average over (pings)

dot_size.description: Diameter of the dot in pixels.
dot_size.label: Dot size (px)
